items.name: tideheight
items.description: Returns the water height at a moment.
items.examples:
**Examples**

Height right now

```arcade
TideHeight(Now())
```

Height tomorrow

```arcade
TideHeight(DateAdd(Now(), 1, 'days'))
```

documentation.value:
**[Since version 1.4](https://example.com/arcade/guide/version-matrix)**

Returns the water height at a moment.

**Parameter**

- **moment**: [Date](https://example.com/arcade/guide/types/#date) - The moment to look up.

**Return value**: [Number](https://example.com/arcade/guide/types/#number)
